verdict.rationale: Cognee's core API is built exactly around this story: `.remember` ingests conversational data into a knowledge graph/memory store, `.recall` performs semantic search with auto-routing retrieval strategies, and sessions persist short-term context that can be bridged into permanent memory via `.improve`, enabling persistence across sessions (also exposed via CLI, Python, REST, and MCP). Community commentary raises architectural skepticism (heavy KG setup, vendor lock-in feel) but does not concretely show recall failing to work as documented, so this stays 'full' rather than disputed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks or third-party validation of retrieval accuracy/quality across sessions.
